name: Mikschana
source:
A 6th-rank angel recently promoted by the Marsterria temple to the Fiaspia locality and tasked with investigating the different kingdoms in the region and maintaining the existing balance of power.

Mikschana's main focus of her investigations is the Fiusia holy ground declared off-limits by the archbishop Coudvans. As the story progresses, Mikschana learns of the Guaracouna Fortress and its true nature as a taboo of the ruling pantheon of deities. This spurs Mikschana into attempting to seize control of the fortress as it passes through the Marsterria military camp in order to destroy it.

[Spoiler] Depending on player actions, Mikschana will try to establish friendlier relations with the rest of the party despite her position as overseer of the Fortress, its actions and its inhabitants. As she is relatively young and a career high-flyer, she does not know how to approach the rest of the fortress inhabitants to strike up a rapport with them and asks Avaro for help.

Mikschana either stays with the rest of the party after her mission is complete to keep an eye on Avaro as per Marsterria orders or is  dispatched elsewhere having successfully completed her mission.

[/Spoiler]
